purpose: Fold the platform-name leaf values (services, frameworks, libraries, operating systems, build tools) into one open value group: platform_label::<name>. A new platform needs no entry.

group.definition: A source-supplied name of a software platform, service, framework, library, package, build tool or operating system (platform_label::django, platform_label::windows). Denotes that named system only; no version, vendor, capability or relation between systems is implied.
group.not: The project being edited when the source does not say so (a repository named django is code_entity/software_version context), a programming-language feature, or a file format.

recognition: Spell the key as the source's name in lower case with underscores for spaces or hyphens (scikit-learn -> scikit_learn, PyTorch Lightning -> pytorch_lightning).
